title: Universal Bonus Pack
summary: 5 furniture items that work in any office. Wall clock, fire extinguisher, vending machine, kanban board, pizza stack. Every office has these.
content:
Universal Bonus Pack

Steffen | 2026-03-16 5 items. Every office needs these.

Pack Contents

# Item ID Name Default Room
1 cr-wall-clock-v Voxel Wall Clock all
2 cr-fire-ext Voxel Fire Extinguisher main-hall, elon
3 cr-vending Voxel Vending Machine main-hall
4 cr-kanban Voxel Kanban Board mom, main-hall, alex
5 cr-pizza-stack Voxel Pizza Box Stack main-hall, bobby

Design Theme

The stuff every office has regardless of industry. A clock to watch the deadline approach. A vending machine for 3pm crashes. A kanban board for tracking the chaos. Pizza boxes for the team. Fire extinguisher because safety first (and metaphorically because everything is on fire).

Renders

All 5 items have transparent PNG renders at 128x128px and JSON sidecars with full metadata.
